generated_from: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API: adverse-event modules of completed interventional trials with posted results, event groups attributed to formulations by brain/product_resolver.py and MedDRA terms mapped to symptom domains by brain/meddra_map.json (brain/aggregate_trials.py).

source.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
source.detail: Adverse-event modules of 191 completed interventional trials with posted results; 286 of 542 event groups attributed to a catalogue formulation.
source.measures: participants reporting an event, out of participants at risk, per arm
source.licence_note: ClinicalTrials.gov results data are in the public domain.

caveats: Figures are participants reporting an event in trial adverse-event tables, not incidence in the general population.
Trial populations, durations and reporting thresholds differ between trials, so cross-product comparison is indicative only.
A term absent from a trial's table is censored below that trial's reporting threshold, not zero.
Comparator arms are included: a product is counted wherever it was an arm, not only where it was the study drug.
The mapping of MedDRA terms to symptom domains is not yet clinician-validated.
Some products are dominated by a single large trial; see composition.
